barman_home.description: Root directory where Barman stores its configuration, logs, and backup metadata.

barman_locks.description: Directory for Barman lock files (used for concurrent operation safety).

barman_log_file.description: Path to the main Barman log file.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

wal_retention_policy.description: Number of days to retain WAL files before automatic cleanup (0 to disable).

parallel_jobs.description: Maximum number of parallel jobs for backup and recovery operations.

ssh_command.description: SSH command used to connect to PostgreSQL servers (used by default if per-server override not set).

rsync_ssh_command.description: SSH command used for rsync transfers to PostgreSQL servers.

servers.description: List of PostgreSQL servers to manage with Barman.

name.description: Unique identifier (section name) for the server in Barman config.

description.description: Human-readable description of the PostgreSQL server.

conninfo_host.description: Hostname or IP of the PostgreSQL server for main connection.

conninfo_user.description: PostgreSQL user used for Barman connections (must have replication privileges).

ssh_command.description: Optional SSH command override for this server (leave empty to use global default).

pg_data_directory.description: Path to PostgreSQL data directory on the remote server.

pg_bin_directory.description: Path to PostgreSQL binaries on the remote server.

pg_config_directory.description: Path to PostgreSQL configuration directory on the remote server.

base_backup_method.description: Method for base backup (e.g., 'postgres' for pg_basebackup).

streaming_archiver.description: Enable WAL streaming from this server ('on' or 'off').

streaming_conninfo_user.description: User for streaming replication (must have REPLICATION privilege).

archive_timeout.description: Force switch of WAL file after this many seconds (0 to disable).

min_wal_size_to_keep.description: Minimum WAL size to retain before cleanup (e.g., '8GB', '32').

max_wal_size_to_keep.description: Maximum WAL size to retain before cleanup.

compression.description: Compression for this server (overrides global default if set).

compression_filter.description: Custom compression command (overrides global default if set).

archive_directory.description: Local path for archived WAL files for this server (if different from default).

check_postgreSQL.description: Enable check that PostgreSQL is running and accessible.

check_wal_archive.description: Enable check that WAL archiving is working.

check_min_wal_size.description: Enable check of WAL minimum size policy.

check_archiver.description: Enable check of WAL archiver status.

check_backup.description: Enable check of backup retention policy.

check_wal_archive_latency.description: Enable check for WAL archiving latency/delay.
